subject.title: fix(ui): cap sidebar child sessions with show-more, drop Subagent prefix in tree

question: Should the sidebar fetch or otherwise propagate descendant run state before applying the child cap, so a quiet direct child cannot conceal a live nested session?
rationale: The intended UX is clear, but choosing the authoritative source and timing for nested descendant activity crosses the sidebar data-loading boundary and needs owner confirmation.

options.title: Preserve nested live branches before capping
options.body: Ensure each child branch carries authoritative descendant activity before filtering, then prove the lazy-loaded nested-running case.

options.title: Limit the initial cap to direct-child state
options.body: Accept that initially unfetched nested live sessions may remain hidden until the user expands more children.

recommendation.title: Preserve nested live branches before capping
recommendation.body: Ensure each child branch carries authoritative descendant activity before filtering, then prove the lazy-loaded nested-running case.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged and proposed Control UI sidebar work makes this the best available owner for the data-loading boundary decision.
